mapper.select: SELECT space_banner_url, space_banner_position, space_banner_view FROM user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(current_coin_count, 0) FROM user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(current_coin_count, 0) FROM user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: s.skin_id, s.name, s.coin_price, s.listed, s.sort_order, s.version, (SELECT a.artwork_id FROM space_product_artwork a WHERE a.skin_id = s.skin_id AND a.standalone) AS single_artwork_id, (SELECT JSON_OBJECTAGG(a.slot, a.artwork_id) FROM space_product_artwork a WHERE a.skin_id = s.skin_id) AS artworks_json
mapper.select: WHERE s.listed = TRUE OR u.skin_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.skin_id
WHERE s.skin_id = #{productId} FOR SHARE OF s
SELECT , FALSE AS owned FROM space_skin s ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.skin_id
mapper.sql: a.artwork_id, a.slot, a.name, a.artist, a.version, a.assets, a.settings
mapper.select: SELECT FROM space_artwork a WHERE NOT a.withdrawn ORDER BY a.slot, a.name, a.artwork_id
SELECT FROM user_equipped_artwork e JOIN space_artwork a ON a.artwork_id = e.artwork_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT e.user_id, FROM user_equipped_artwork e JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = e.user_id AND u.status = 1 JOIN space_artwork a ON a.artwork_id = e.artwork_id WHERE e.slot = #{slot} AND e.user_id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT FROM user_space_skin u JOIN space_product_artwork p ON p.skin_id = u.skin_id JOIN space_artwork a ON a.artwork_id = p.artwork_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND a.slot = #{slot} ORDER BY a.name, a.artwork_id
SELECT FROM space_artwork a WHERE a.artwork_id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM space_artwork a WHERE a.artwork_id = #{id} AND NOT a.withdrawn FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_space_skin u JOIN space_product_artwork a ON a.skin_id = u.skin_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND a.artwork_id = #{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE space_artwork SET name = #{name}, artist = #{artist}, version = version + 1 WHERE artwork_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND NOT withdrawn

UPDATE space_artwork SET withdrawn = TRUE, version = version + 1 WHERE artwork_id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND NOT withdrawn AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM space_product_artwork a JOIN space_skin s ON s.skin_id = a.skin_id WHERE a.artwork_id = #{id} AND (s.listed OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_space_skin u WHERE u.skin_id = s.skin_id)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO space_artwork (artwork_id, slot, name, artist, assets, settings) VALUES (#{id}, #{slot}, #{name}, #{artist}, #{assets}, #{settings,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO space_product_artwork (skin_id, slot, artwork_id, standalone) VALUES (#{product}, #{slot}, #{artwork}, #{single})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_equipped_artwork WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND slot = #{slot}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_equipped_artwork (user_id, slot, artwork_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{slot}, #{id})
mapper.select: SELECT skin_id FROM user_space_skin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_space_skin (user_id, skin_id, request_id, purchase_id, paid_coins) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{requestId}, #{purchaseId}, #{price})
INSERT INTO coin_ledger (user_id, order_id, business_type, delta) VALUES (#{userId}, #{purchaseId}, 'SKIN', #{delta})
mapper.select: SELECT u.purchase_id, COALESCE(s.name, u.skin_id) AS title, u.paid_coins, u.acquired_at FROM user_space_skin u LEFT JOIN space_skin s ON s.skin_id = u.skin_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.paid_coins > 0 ORDER BY u.acquired_at DESC, u.purchase_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO space_skin (skin_id, name, coin_price, listed, sort_order) VALUES (#{productId}, #{name}, #{price}, TRUE, 100)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET space_banner_url = #{url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, space_banner_position = #{position}, space_banner_view = #{view,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_info SET space_banner_position = #{position}, space_banner_view = #{view} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
